source_backbone: Royal Botanic Gardens Kew POWO/WCVP (2026); Fox & Hatch 1999 Sida 18:1037–1047; Flora of North Central Texas (Diggs et al.); Flora of North America; Delfini et al. 2023 Plants 12:749
accepted_infraspecifics: Setaria reverchonii subsp. firmula (Hitchc. & Chase) W.E.Fox

prior_taxonomy_evidence.scope: Earlier accepted-species/three-subspecies summary; this record verifies historical rank, basionyms and conflicting treatments in detail.

native_range_audit: DEFERRED — NOT REVIEWED; all county and native metrics untouched
photo_and_specimen_identity: HOLD — subspecies and individual voucher identity not independently certified
install_decision: Retain one canonical Setaria reverchonii species card; no subspecies cards or historical genus duplicate installations from taxonomy-only findings.

decisions.subject: Setaria reverchonii (Vasey) Pilg.
decisions.proposed_decision: Retain accepted species in Poaceae, Setaria, rank species, authorship (Vasey) Pilg.
decisions.detail: POWO/WCVP accepts the 1940 combination; current installed species-level name is correct.

decisions.subject: Panicum reverchonii Vasey
decisions.proposed_decision: Map as homotypic basionym to accepted Setaria reverchonii; preserve searchable historical spelling
decisions.detail: Original publication 1889; not a separate learner species.

decisions.subject: Chaetochloa reverchonii (Vasey) Smyth
decisions.proposed_decision: Map as homotypic synonym of Setaria reverchonii

decisions.subject: Setaria reverchonii subsp. reverchonii
decisions.proposed_decision: Recognize accepted autonym at subspecies rank; no automatic assignment of any existing photo
decisions.detail: One of three accepted infraspecific taxa in POWO/WCVP.

decisions.subject: Setaria reverchonii subsp. firmula (Hitchc. & Chase) W.E.Fox
decisions.proposed_decision: Recognize accepted subspecies (Fox & Hatch 1999); not accepted independent species under POWO

decisions.subject: Panicum firmulum Hitchc. & Chase
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to S. reverchonii subsp. firmula as homotypic synonym
decisions.detail: Basionym from 1910, not synonym of subspecies reverchonii by default.

decisions.subject: Setaria firmula (Hitchc. & Chase) Pilg.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to S. reverchonii subsp. firmula, not a fourth accepted Setaria species

decisions.subject: Setaria reverchonii subsp. ramiseta (Scribn.) W.E.Fox
decisions.proposed_decision: Recognize accepted subspecies (Fox & Hatch 1999), distinct from subsp. firmula and autonym

decisions.subject: Panicum ramisetum Scribn.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map as homotypic basionym to S. reverchonii subsp. ramiseta

decisions.subject: Setaria ramiseta (Scribn.) Pilg.
decisions.proposed_decision: Map to accepted S. reverchonii subsp. ramiseta under POWO; preserve historical species-rank label
decisions.detail: 1940 combination; Texas flora sometimes uses this species-rank concept.

decisions.subject: Chaetochloa ramiseta (Scribn.) Smyth
decisions.proposed_decision: Map as homotypic synonym of S. reverchonii subsp. ramiseta

decisions.subject: Panicum subspicatum Vasey (1889)
decisions.proposed_decision: Recognize illegitimate later homonym as heterotypic synonym of S. reverchonii subsp. ramiseta, not accepted Panicum species
decisions.detail: POWO marks nom. illeg. homonym. post.; do not confuse with any earlier homonym.

decisions.subject: Automatically create separate canonical species cards for Setaria firmula and Setaria ramiseta
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject duplicate installations: both are POWO accepted subspecies of existing S. reverchonii
decisions.detail: Historical species rank does not equal current accepted rank.

decisions.subject: Automatically label source photographs as subsp. firmula, ramiseta, or reverchonii based on species-level determination
decisions.proposed_decision: Reject unsupported subspecies inference; keep original species label and HOLD
decisions.detail: Species-level photo or locality is insufficient to identify subspecies; no specimen-level determination completed.

decisions.subject: Infraspecific identity of existing Setaria reverchonii learner images and specimens
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve subspecies ID HOLD pending same-specimen voucher and diagnostic character evidence
decisions.detail: The current card is source-labelled and has no confirmed infraspecific voucher; do not reassign any photograph.

decisions.subject: Hybrid or introgression ancestry of individual Setaria reverchonii specimens
decisions.proposed_decision: Do not infer hybrid ancestry from historical ranks, taxonomic literature, or species-level photographs
decisions.detail: No verified named hybrid or specimen-specific ancestry is established by this review.

decisions.subject: Texas flora species-level Setaria ramiseta versus POWO/WCVP subspecies rank
decisions.proposed_decision: Document competing taxonomic treatments; use POWO subspecies backbone, preserve alternate species-rank name for source lookup
decisions.detail: Flora of North Central Texas discusses S. ramiseta as distinct from S. reverchonii; POWO/WCVP accepts it under S. reverchonii.

decisions.subject: Alternative Paspalidium generic placements for reverchonii, firmula and ramiseta
decisions.proposed_decision: Preserve 2006 alternative genus treatments as taxon-concept caution; do not replace current accepted Setaria backbone
decisions.detail: POWO notes alternative 2006 World Grass Species Synonymy cited Paspalidium reverchonii, firmulum, ramisetum. Current POWO names remain Setaria; exact alternative combinations are not installed.
